title: [Bug] Not all Qwen models support the "enable_search" parameter
body:
### 📦 Environment

Docker

### 📌 Version

v1.43.1

### 💻 Operating System

Other Linux

### 🌐 Browser

Chrome

### 🐛 Bug Description

In #5039, we added the `enable_search` parameter to Qwen model requests according to the [documentation](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dashscope/developer-reference/qwen-api#ea3869ca53mh4). However, not all Qwen models support this parameter. e.g. `qwen2.5-3b-instruct`.

https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/89a60e3e19aec8fae032dbb7f1b208ff493b3e04/src/libs/agent-runtime/qwen/index.ts#L36-L41

#### 🔀 变更说明 | Description of Change

1. `enable_search` 仅对商业模型 `qwen-max`, `qwen-plus`, `qwen-turbo` 系列生效
2. 引入两个环境变量

|变量名|描述|默认值|可选值|
|-|-|-|-|
|QWEN_ENABLE_SEARCH|模型在生成文本时是否使用互联网搜索结果进行参考|0|1|
|QWEN_SEARCH_STRATEGY|搜索互联网信息的数量|standard|pro|

- close #5296
- close #5400

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This is an agent issue as it involves an "Incompatible parameters to LLM providers" problem, where the `enable_search` parameter is not supported by all Qwen models, impacting the integration with the LLM provider.
